scoring_methodology.summary: Each account receives a risk_score from 0–100. Points from multiple flags add together. The total is capped at 100. Risk bands: Low 0–24, Medium 25–49, High 50+ (thresholds configurable in config.json).
order_of_operations: Per-account email, device, IP velocity, and geo-cluster rules run on each lead/registration row.
Affiliate batch rules (sequential email, woman concentration, domain concentration) run on the same dataset and flag only matching accounts.
Admin enrichment adds payment, GeoIP, email-validation timing, and content-review flags for enriched (typically paid) accounts.
Post-enrichment batch rules (e.g. Discover concentration per affiliate) apply after enrichment completes.
not_scored: Raw registration IP ≠ login IP (users switch Wi‑Fi/mobile) — only geo-based mismatches are scored.
Apple Private Relay and phone-registration placeholder domains skip local-part email pattern rules.

EXCESSIVE_DOTS.trigger: More than 3 period characters in the email local part (before @).
EXCESSIVE_DOTS.explanation: Fraud farms often insert extra dots in Gmail-style addresses to create many unique-looking emails from one inbox or to evade naive duplicate checks. Legitimate users rarely use more than three dots in a username.
EXCESSIVE_DOTS.investigation: Compare with affiliate source and other email pattern flags. Multiple structure flags on one account increases confidence of templated signup.

DIGIT_SUFFIX.trigger: Local part ends with exactly 4 or 5 consecutive digits.
DIGIT_SUFFIX.explanation: Bulk-generated accounts frequently append numeric suffixes to reuse a name stem across thousands of registrations.
DIGIT_SUFFIX.investigation: Look for SEQUENTIAL_EMAIL or NAME_NUMBER_PATTERN on the same affiliate; check IP velocity and shared IP.

SCRAMBLED_PATTERN.trigger: Heuristic detects low vowel ratio and random-looking consonant clusters in the local part.
SCRAMBLED_PATTERN.explanation: Automatically generated strings often lack natural language letter patterns. This catches machine-created inboxes that are not obviously name-based.
SCRAMBLED_PATTERN.investigation: High value combined with fast email validation or POV timing. Review profile images via CONTENT_REVIEW when present.

NAME_NUMBER_PATTERN.trigger: Local part matches firstname+number+lastname+number style templates.
NAME_NUMBER_PATTERN.explanation: One of the highest-yield automated rules: fraud operations use predictable name-and-number email templates across campaigns.
NAME_NUMBER_PATTERN.investigation: Prioritize for manual review; often appears in clusters from the same affiliate. Pair with sequential email detection.

WRITTEN_NUMBER_PATTERN.trigger: Local part contains English written numbers (e.g. one, two, three).
WRITTEN_NUMBER_PATTERN.explanation: Some generators embed spelled-out numbers to vary addresses while keeping a scriptable pattern.
WRITTEN_NUMBER_PATTERN.investigation: Usually secondary signal; escalate when combined with other email flags.

REPEATED_WORD_PATTERN.trigger: A word from the local part appears in more than 3 emails in the current analysis batch (config: repeated_word_threshold).
REPEATED_WORD_PATTERN.explanation: Batch-level frequency detection finds shared tokens across many signups in the same run—common when a script reuses vocabulary.
REPEATED_WORD_PATTERN.investigation: Inspect the repeated word in details; drill into affiliate and time window for the batch.

SUSPICIOUS_NAME.trigger: Local part contains a name from the configured suspicious_names list (default includes fatima, muhammed).
SUSPICIOUS_NAME.explanation: Names that recur disproportionately in confirmed fraud are flagged for review. List is editable in config.
SUSPICIOUS_NAME.investigation: Validate against recent confirmed fraud outcomes; propose list updates monthly.

GENDER_NAME_MISMATCH.trigger: Gender inferred from email/name (gender-guesser) conflicts with declared gender (user1/custom_u1), high-confidence only.
GENDER_NAME_MISMATCH.explanation: Declares one gender but uses an email local part strongly associated with another—common in misrepresented or scripted profiles.
GENDER_NAME_MISMATCH.investigation: Androgynous or unknown names are skipped. Confirm declared gender and billing name on paid accounts.

BILLING_GENDER_MISMATCH.trigger: Paid records: billing first name gender ≠ declared gender (high-confidence only).
BILLING_GENDER_MISMATCH.explanation: Payment name inconsistent with profile gender is a strong paid-fraud indicator—often chargeback or stolen-card scenarios.
BILLING_GENDER_MISMATCH.investigation: Cross-check shared_card flags and card type. Confirm with processor billing data.

theme_cluster.trigger: Local part contains keywords for real estate, construction, crypto, or finance themes.
theme_cluster.explanation: Theme clustering groups niche keyword spam that appears in coordinated fraud waves (investment/crypto scams, etc.). Stored flag: THEME_CLUSTER_<THEME>.
theme_cluster.investigation: Review campaign and affiliate; themes often spike together in time.

POV_INSTANT_VALIDATION_20S.trigger: CSV POV fields: email verified within 20 seconds of signup.
POV_INSTANT_VALIDATION_20S.explanation: Human users rarely complete verification instantly; sub-20s timing suggests automation or pre-validated inboxes.
POV_INSTANT_VALIDATION_20S.investigation: Treat as critical if Admin email_validated timing confirms. Highest priority queue.

POV_INSTANT_VALIDATION_40S.explanation: Still abnormally fast for organic signup; slightly lower weight than 20s tier.
POV_INSTANT_VALIDATION_40S.investigation: Compare with Admin validation timestamps when available.

POV_FAST_VALIDATION_60S.explanation: Fast validation band; meaningful when combined with other fraud signals.
POV_FAST_VALIDATION_60S.investigation: Use as supporting signal unless affiliate shows widespread fast POV.

email_validated.trigger: Admin API: seconds from account creation to email validation ≤ 60 or ≤ 120.
email_validated.explanation: Strongest automated signal when platform timestamps are available—mirrors manual POV analysis at scale.
email_validated.investigation: Prioritize ≤60s accounts for affiliate termination discussions. Flag stored as email_validated_{N}s(+points).

SEQUENTIAL_EMAIL.trigger: Same affiliate: same letter stem (≥4 chars) + same domain, with 4+ distinct numeric suffixes on local part.
SEQUENTIAL_EMAIL.explanation: Detects factory-style email generation (e.g. maucheesee71@, maucheesee76@) without requiring consecutive numbers.
SEQUENTIAL_EMAIL.investigation: Affiliate-level abuse indicator—review entire affiliate cohort sharing the stem.

WOMAN_CONCENTRATION.trigger: Affiliate WOMAN share ≥ ~15% (configurable in build_gender_concentration_map) with sufficient sample; baseline ~0.9%.
WOMAN_CONCENTRATION.explanation: Flags only WOMAN registrations from affiliates with abnormal gender mix—often mislabeled or scripted female profiles.
WOMAN_CONCENTRATION.investigation: Affiliate quality conversation; compare to campaign and geo. Only flagged gender rows receive points.

AFFILIATE_DOMAIN_CONCENTRATION.trigger: Affiliate has ≥20 emails in batch; non-excluded domain (default: not gmail.com) is ≥5% of that affiliate's domains.
AFFILIATE_DOMAIN_CONCENTRATION.explanation: Fraud sources funnel traffic through disposable or niche domains. Gmail is excluded by default because it dominates legitimate traffic.
AFFILIATE_DOMAIN_CONCENTRATION.investigation: Inspect domain WHOIS/reputation; only accounts on the concentrated domain are flagged—not all affiliate traffic.

score_tiers.condition: Email domain matches concentrated pair (affiliate, domain)

IP_VELOCITY_HIGH.trigger: Registration IP has 10+ signups within one hour in the analysis batch (config: ip_velocity_threshold).
IP_VELOCITY_HIGH.explanation: Classic fraud-ring signal—single IP driving volume in a short window.
IP_VELOCITY_HIGH.investigation: Check SHARED_IP flags and datacenter/VPN ASN. Consider IP block at affiliate level.

IP_VELOCITY_MEDIUM.trigger: Registration IP has 5–9 signups within one hour in batch.
IP_VELOCITY_MEDIUM.explanation: Elevated velocity; weaker alone but useful in combination.
IP_VELOCITY_MEDIUM.investigation: Trend IP over multiple days if data available.

SHARED_IP_HIGH.trigger: Same registration IP appears on 10+ accounts in the batch.
SHARED_IP_HIGH.explanation: Shared infrastructure—café, VPN, or fraud farm.
SHARED_IP_HIGH.investigation: Distinguish datacenter vs residential via enrichment flags.

SHARED_IP_MEDIUM.trigger: Same registration IP on 3–9 accounts in batch.
SHARED_IP_MEDIUM.explanation: Moderate sharing; may be legitimate NAT but worth review on high-payout affiliates.

DESKTOP_DEVICE_SUSPICIOUS.trigger: Signup user-agent indicates desktop; Windows 10 vs other desktop OS tiers.
DESKTOP_DEVICE_SUSPICIOUS.explanation: Fraud farms often use Windows 10 desktops at scale; other desktops scored lower.
DESKTOP_DEVICE_SUSPICIOUS.investigation: Combine with IP and email signals—desktop alone is weak.

SAME_US_STATE_CLUSTER.trigger: 3+ accounts in batch share the same US state (geo from data).
SAME_US_STATE_CLUSTER.explanation: Geographic clustering can indicate targeted fraud or proxy concentration.
SAME_US_STATE_CLUSTER.investigation: Compare to affiliate's expected geo; check city-level cluster flag.

SAME_US_CITY_STATE_CLUSTER.trigger: 3+ accounts share same US city and state.
SAME_US_CITY_STATE_CLUSTER.explanation: Tighter cluster than state-only—higher confidence of coordinated signups.
SAME_US_CITY_STATE_CLUSTER.investigation: Map to IP clusters and registration times.

SAME_INTL_COUNTRY_CITY_CLUSTER.explanation: International city clustering—common in outsourced fraud operations.

ip_country_mismatch.trigger: GeoIP country of registration IP ≠ GeoIP country of login IP.
ip_country_mismatch.explanation: Cross-country movement between signup and login is suspicious on dating products when paired with other signals. Different from raw IP string mismatch.
ip_country_mismatch.investigation: Confirm countries in flag text. High-risk login country adds separate points.

ip_state_mismatch.trigger: Same country but US state (or region) differs between registration and login IP.
ip_state_mismatch.explanation: Cross-state moves happen legitimately but add risk when combined with automation signals.
ip_state_mismatch.investigation: Not scored for different cities within same state.

login_high_risk_country.trigger: Login IP country in config high_risk_countries (default: NG, GH, CI, CM, PH, RO, MD, ID).
login_high_risk_country.explanation: Login from geographies over-represented in dating fraud ops.
login_high_risk_country.investigation: Validate against declared geo in CSV; list is configurable.

geo_login_mismatch.trigger: Login IP country ≠ geo_country from affiliate/leads CSV.
geo_login_mismatch.explanation: Cross-source inconsistency—lead data says one country, login IP another.
geo_login_mismatch.investigation: Data quality vs fraud—check if CSV geo is stale or VPN-related.

registration_ip_datacenter.trigger: Registration IP ASN classified as datacenter/cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.).
registration_ip_datacenter.explanation: Consumer dating signups rarely originate from cloud host IPs.
registration_ip_datacenter.investigation: ASN name appears in flag. Pair with email automation flags.

login_ip_datacenter.explanation: Bots and scripted logins often use hosted infrastructure.

registration_ip_vpn.trigger: Registration IP ASN matches known VPN/proxy providers.
registration_ip_vpn.explanation: Anonymized registration path—elevated risk on affiliate traffic.
registration_ip_vpn.investigation: VPN at registration + fast validation is high priority.

login_ip_vpn.explanation: Common for fraud operators masking location.

shared_card.trigger: Confirmed shared card (Used By, not fuzzy match) links account to 3+ or 5+ other DUIDs; major issuers excluded.
shared_card.explanation: Same payment credential across many accounts indicates fraud ring or stolen card testing.
shared_card.investigation: Use Admin shared cards view; 5+ is ring-level priority. QA cards/DUIDs can be whitelisted in config.

amex_card.trigger: Any Amex cardType on account payment methods.
amex_card.explanation: Amex has near-zero baseline on typical dating traffic—any appearance is anomalous.
amex_card.investigation: Verify charge outcomes; check billing gender mismatch.

business_card.explanation: Business cards are inherently unusual for consumer dating purchases.
business_card.investigation: Confirm description text in Admin; no issuer exclusions.

discover_concentration.trigger: Post-enrichment: affiliate has >10% Discover cards among enriched accounts (default), minimum 10 enriched accounts.
discover_concentration.explanation: Discover baseline ~2% site-wide; affiliate-level spikes suggest bad traffic mix.
discover_concentration.investigation: Only Discover-card accounts flagged. Affiliate negotiation / cap traffic.

CONTENT_REVIEW.trigger: Profile image uploaded AND (upload <180s after registration OR suspicious email/identity flags).
CONTENT_REVIEW.explanation: Queues accounts for manual image review (stock, stolen, AI faces)—not always a score driver (default 0 points).
CONTENT_REVIEW.investigation: Reverse image search; compare upload timing. Does not replace email/card investigation.

DATA_QUALITY_MISSING_EMAIL.trigger: Email field empty or missing on input row.
DATA_QUALITY_MISSING_EMAIL.explanation: Row skipped for pattern analysis; indicates export or pipeline data gap.
DATA_QUALITY_MISSING_EMAIL.investigation: Fix upstream data—not a fraud finding.
